about: Regression thresholds for src/delta.py. A regression is a cell that dropped rank between two runs (see src/verdicts.py); weight is what a reader loses (see src/severity.py). Pick a profile with --profile; `allow` is shared by both and exempts cells whose verdict depends on the machine rather than on pandoc.

allow.reason: the pdf writer needs an external TeX engine, so this row measures whether the runner has one

pin.description: the repo's own results against the pinned pandoc: nothing may move without a human deciding it should

nightly.description: the watch on pandoc's nightly build: upstream restyles writers all the time, so presentation may move; content may not
